# Frank Tindle

> Operations executive. Thirty-one years building the teams that keep
> businesses running. Based in Surrey, UK.

## Summary

Frank Tindle is an operations and technology executive with 31 years in the
video games industry, currently IT & Operations Director at Supermassive Games.

## Career

- **Supermassive Games** (2010–present) — IT & Operations Director. Joined at 30
  employees; the studio grew to a multi-site group peaking at 387 staff, peak turnover
  of £39.1M (FY2022), and was acquired by Nordisk Games (Egmont) in July 2022.
  Built the operations function from a standing start to a team of 15, covering IT,
  workplace support, facilities, physical and cyber security, events and
  procurement. Operating budget grew from £200K to a peak of £6M. Member of the
  Senior Leadership Team.
- **Criterion Games / Electronic Arts** (2001–2008) — Senior Manager, IT
  Services. IT integration following EA's £40M acquisition in 2004, covering
  Guildford, Paris, Austin and Tokyo, 300+ employees, with no disruption to game
  releases.
- **Acclaim Studios Teesside / Iguana Entertainment** (1995–1999) — Director of
  Operations. Joined shortly after Acclaim's acquisition of Iguana in January 1995; built a
  unified email system across sites in New York, Austin, Utah and the UK.

## Areas of expertise

Post-acquisition integration (three acquisitions across three decades), scaling
operations through rapid growth, office moves and estates, business continuity,
cyber and physical security, procurement and vendor management, org design
through both growth and contraction, and applying AI to back-office work.
